title: Back from a market detail screen returns to Perps home after a Lite/Pro round trip
description: Walks the reported journey: from Perps home the user opens the BTC market in Lite, switches to the Pro workstation, switches back to Lite, then presses the header back arrow. The back arrow must return the user to Perps home instead of dropping them out to the wallet home screen. Data prerequisites: the fixture 'Trading' account, unlocked by metamask.wallet.ensure_unlocked; no positions, orders, or balance are required because both ACs are navigational.

setup-status.intent: Confirm the mobile bridge is reachable

setup-unlock.intent: Make the wallet usable before the journey starts

setup-perps-home.intent: Begin the journey on Perps home, where the reporter starts

setup-wait-home.intent: Confirm Perps home is on screen before the user opens a market

setup-open-market.intent: Open the BTC market the way the user does, by tapping its row on Perps home

setup-ensure-lite.intent: Begin on the Lite market page, matching the reported starting point

ac2-wait-lite-start.intent: Confirm the Lite market page is the screen the user sees first

ac2-switch-to-pro.intent: Take the user to the Pro workstation from the Lite market page

ac2-wait-pro.intent: Confirm the user is looking at the Pro workstation order form

ac2-screenshot-pro.intent: Show the Pro workstation the user reaches from the Lite market page
ac2-screenshot-pro.label: AC2: Pro workstation reached from Lite

ac2-switch-back-lite.intent: Take the user back to the Lite market page from the Pro workstation

ac2-wait-lite-return.intent: Confirm the user is back on the Lite market page and can act on it

ac2-screenshot-lite-return.intent: Show the Lite market page the user returns to from the Pro workstation
ac2-screenshot-lite-return.label: AC2: Lite market page after returning from Pro

ac1-press-back.intent: Leave the market page the way the user does, using the header back arrow

ac1-wait-perps-home.intent: The user must arrive on Perps home, so its watchlist must be on screen

ac1-assert-not-wallet.intent: The user must land on Perps home with its balance actions, not on a market page

ac1-screenshot-landing.intent: Show that the user lands on Perps home rather than the wallet home screen
ac1-screenshot-landing.label: AC1: back arrow returns the user to Perps home
